preview: St Kitts & Nevis Patriots face Antigua & Barbuda Falcons in CPL 2026 Match 21 at Warner Park. The match is scheduled for Sun 30 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The Patriots unite CPL's leading career run-scorer Johnson Charles with Andre Fletcher, while Jason Holder returns to strengthen an experienced Caribbean group. The Falcons bring Antiguan fast bowler Alzarri Joseph home for 2026 and add Evin Lewis to a returning core that includes Fabian Allen, Jayden Seales and Amir Jangoo. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
